tldr: Mars in the 10th house routes drive and action through public contribution.
body: With Mars in the 10th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through career, public role, reputation, authority, and legacy. This makes how you become visible, take responsibility, and build a life that can be recognized a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through public contribution.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in public contribution.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
